booking.card.action_restore_booking.description: Booking card action on a CANCELLED booking: puts it back on the calendar as Confirmed (the pre-cancellation status is not stored).

booking.card.restored.description: Snackbar shown after a cancelled booking is restored and its dates are free.

booking.card.restore_conflict_warning.value: {count, plural, one {बुकिंग बहाल हो गई — इन तारीख़ों पर # और बुकिंग है।} other {बुकिंग बहाल हो गई — इन तारीख़ों पर # और बुकिंग हैं।}}
booking.card.restore_conflict_warning.description: Non-blocking snackbar after restoring a cancelled booking whose dates now overlap other active bookings. ICU plural; count is the number of overlapping bookings. The restore still succeeds — halls can host multiple events.

booking.card.action_delete_booking.description: Booking card action on a CANCELLED booking: permanently removes it (soft-delete tombstone) from every view. Distinct from Cancel booking, which only releases the date.

booking.card.delete_confirm_title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before permanently deleting a cancelled booking.

booking.card.delete_confirm_message.value: बुकिंग और उसका भुगतान इतिहास सभी जगहों से हटा दिया जाएगा। इसे वापस नहीं किया जा सकता।
booking.card.delete_confirm_message.description: Body of the permanent-delete confirmation dialog for a cancelled booking.

booking.card.deleted.description: Snackbar shown after a cancelled booking is permanently deleted.
